newsitem.title: USA: Airbus would consider exclusive agreement.
newsitem.headline: Airbus would consider exclusive agreement.

text.p: Airbus Industrie would "seriously consider" the same exclusive purchase agreements that have become a sore point in the proposed merger of Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp, a spokeswoman said Thursday.

"Airbus will always try to fill market demand," the spokeswoman said. "We would consider (exclusive agreements) seriously. We do obviously object to the exclusive deals -- we think they're anticompetitive -- but so far they're not against the law.

EU Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert has said the EU cannot permit the merger of Boeing and McDonnell Douglas so long as Boeing has exclusive 20-year provider agreements with AMR Corp's American Airlines and Delta Air Lines Inc.
Boeing is reported to be negotiating another, similar deal with Continental Airlines Inc.
Critics have argued Airbus has its own exclusive deal with US Airways Inc already, but US Airways recently said it continues to consider Boeing as a possible supplier.
